key_insight: README.md must be updated in every PR that adds a command, subcommand, flag, or user-visible behaviour — documentation drift is invisible without explicitly checking it
decision: README update is part of every feature PR's definition of done — check git log --follow -- README.md before opening a PR.
alternatives_considered: storing in agent memory only — rejected, does not survive across all agent sessions or apply to other agents on this repo
validation_plan: Verify README is touched in every feat/* PR before merge
